Standalone PDF text extraction using extract

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(filename: 'fake_memo.pdf', kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/pdf', uri: 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf'))
puts result.results[0].metadata.inspect
```
